current.text: He went undrafted in the 2026 NBA draft and signed a two-way deal after the draft. That deal was with the Bucks. He is now with the Lakers.
Experts rate him only as a late dynasty rookie flier, around pick 50 in rookie drafts. He is worth watching, not drafting.
Walker Kessler is the Lakers starting center. Backup center is an open question, with Kevon Looney and Mamukelashvili ahead in line for those minutes.
The Lakers' backup centers are weak and the team depends on Kessler. A Kessler injury is the main way a backup big could get real minutes.

durable.text: He is a 6'11 big man, 23 years old at the 2026 draft.
In college he had a very high block rate, a very high steal rate and a high free throw rate. He does not take threes.
His steal and block numbers translate well to the NBA. Experts compare him to Paul Reed.

tags.name: minutes competition
tags.detail: Behind Kessler, Looney and Mamukelashvili at center.

tags.name: waiver watch
tags.detail: Steals and blocks big. Watch if Kessler gets hurt.

note: Castro is not a draft option in our league. Yahoo values him at 0 USD and ranks him 672, ESPN does not list him, and nobody in our league drafted him last season. His only fantasy interest is a stocks profile: high steal and block rates from a big, no threes, and a high free throw rate. Leave him on waivers and check in early in the season whether he is on the Lakers' active roster and whether a Kessler injury opens backup center minutes.
